summary: Vote in progress: 0 binding +1 Uroš Bojanić proposes cutting a 4.0.5 release candidate after the 4.1.4 RC2, noting that the 4.0 branch has accumulated many fixes and will soon reach its 18‑month support window. Vote in progress: 0 binding +1 The discussion centers on adding the SQL-standard GROUPS window frame to Spark SQL, which currently only supports ROWS and RANGE. It replaces the current practice of using pod service accounts by distributing temporary storage credentials via a new RPC, mirroring existing delegation token patterns. The proposal introduces a unified API and execution protocol for user-defined functions that work across multiple programming languages, enabling Spark to run UDFs outside the engine via inter-process communication.
